ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.label.context_note: Conversation menu. Heads the three-level choice of how often the READER'S OWN AI agent (chief of staff) is woken in this conversation. Distinct from the reader's own notification preferences above it: this setting is about the agent, not about the reader's banners.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.label.context_role: menu section heading / radio group label

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.all.context_note: The agent is woken for every message here and decides for itself whether to reply. '(default)' marks this as the level a new member gets; keep it parenthetical.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.all.context_length: 2-3 words plus the parenthetical; one line in a ~240px menu.

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.mention.context_note: The agent is woken only when someone @-mentions it. Keep '@-mentions' as the product's mention term.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.mention.context_length: 2-3 words; one line in a ~240px menu.

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.mute.context_note: The agent is never woken in this conversation, not even by an @-mention. Describes the agent's state (it never wakes), not an action on the reader.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.mute.context_length: 1-2 words; one line in a ~240px menu.

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.error.value: Your agent’s setting was not saved. Try again.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.error.context_note: A refused write of the reader's own agent's wake level. The menu has closed and the previous level is restored; this line explains why. Mirrors ui.teamBridge.notify.error.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.error.context_role: inline error under the thread header

ui.teamBridge.builtin.agents_topic.value: Every teammate's chief of staff. Agents see every message and reply when relevant or @-mentioned.
ui.teamBridge.builtin.agents_topic.context_note: Describes the built-in #agents channel: every enrolled agent is a member and sees every message; each agent replies when the message is relevant to it or when it is @-mentioned.

ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.value: Accepting lets your agent read and post in this conversation from now on. It sees every message and decides whether to reply; an @-mention means it should reply. You can limit it to @-mentions or mute it.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge Invitations view. A teammate added the reader's own AI agent (chief of staff) to a channel or group; the agent cannot join until its owner accepts. The consent statement the owner agrees to by pressing Accept; the key names the participation version it is consent to (bridge_agent_participation_v2), so ANY change to this English text needs a new version and a new key. Keep every fact: from now on the agent can read the conversation's messages AND post there; it is woken for EVERY message and judges for itself whether to reply; an @-mention means a reply is expected; the owner can narrow it to @-mentions only or mute it (the 'Your agent' menu). 'Mute it' here means the agent is never woken.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.context_length: Two or three sentences; permit wrapping.

ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.value: Accepted. {agent} now sees every message here and replies when it’s relevant or @-mentioned.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge Invitations view. A teammate added the reader's own AI agent (chief of staff) to a channel or group; the agent cannot join until its owner accepts. Once accepted, the agent sees every message and decides whether a reply is needed; an @-mention means it should reply. Outcome after Accept; same wake rule as the consent statement: the agent now receives every message and replies when relevant or when @-mentioned.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.context_length: One or two sentences; permit wrapping.

ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted_unnam.value: Accepted. Your agent now sees every message here and replies when it’s relevant or @-mentioned.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted_unnam.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge Invitations view. A teammate added the reader's own AI agent (chief of staff) to a channel or group; the agent cannot join until its owner accepts. Once accepted, the agent sees every message and decides whether a reply is needed; an @-mention means it should reply. Outcome after Accept; same wake rule as the consent statement: the agent now receives every message and replies when relevant or when @-mentioned. Used when the agent has no name: lowercase sentence-internal wording avoids a capitalized fallback mid-sentence.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted_unnam.context_length: One or two sentences; permit wrapping.

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.mention.translation: Chỉ khi được nhắc đến bằng @

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.error.en: Your agent’s setting was not saved. Try again.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.error.translation: Chưa lưu được cài đặt cho tác nhân của bạn. Hãy thử lại.

ui.teamBridge.builtin.agents_topic.en: Every teammate's chief of staff. Agents see every message and reply when relevant or @-mentioned.
ui.teamBridge.builtin.agents_topic.translation: Chánh văn phòng của mọi đồng nghiệp. Tác nhân xem mọi tin nhắn và trả lời khi có liên quan hoặc khi được nhắc đến bằng @.

ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.en: Accepting lets your agent read and post in this conversation from now on. It sees every message and decides whether to reply; an @-mention means it should reply. You can limit it to @-mentions or mute it.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.translation: Khi chấp nhận, tác nhân của bạn có thể đọc và đăng tin nhắn trong cuộc trò chuyện này kể từ bây giờ. Tác nhân xem mọi tin nhắn và tự quyết định có trả lời hay không; được nhắc đến bằng @ nghĩa là tác nhân nên trả lời. Bạn có thể giới hạn tác nhân chỉ ở các lượt nhắc đến bằng @ hoặc tắt tiếng tác nhân.

ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.en: Accepted. {agent} now sees every message here and replies when it’s relevant or @-mentioned.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.translation: Đã chấp nhận. {agent} giờ xem mọi tin nhắn ở đây và trả lời khi có liên quan hoặc khi được nhắc đến bằng @.

ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted_unnam.en: Accepted. Your agent now sees every message here and replies when it’s relevant or @-mentioned.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted_unnam.translation: Đã chấp nhận. Tác nhân của bạn giờ xem mọi tin nhắn ở đây và trả lời khi có liên quan hoặc khi được nhắc đến bằng @.

findings.detail: '{agent} giờ xem mọi tin nhắn' (and accepted_unnamed) uses the colloquial 'giờ' for 'now'; 'giờ đây' / 'bây giờ' is less ambiguous with 'giờ' = hour. Unambiguous in context and shorter, so accepted unchanged; a native pass may prefer 'giờ đây'.
